routes.name: aql-diagnose
routes.description: Explicit diagnose route: evidence-first read-only investigation with an EVIDENCED terminal ceiling. No local implementation writes.
routes.handoff: Return evidence-backed findings only. Hand off to agent-quality-loop for implement, accept, or release when the user asks.

openai.default_prompt: Use $aql-diagnose to investigate this task read-only and return evidence-backed findings up to EVIDENCED.

routes.name: aql-accept
routes.description: Explicit accept route: independent acceptance review in a fresh acceptor context. Read-only; no repair.
routes.handoff: Return review findings and a conservative verdict. Do not edit artifacts; hand back to agent-quality-loop if repair is requested.

openai.default_prompt: Use $aql-accept to independently review this work in a fresh acceptor context and return a conservative verdict.

routes.name: aql-release-check
routes.description: Explicit release preflight route: readiness check only. Read-only; no release act.
routes.handoff: Return release-readiness findings only. Any publish, deploy, or external release act requires explicit user authority via agent-quality-loop.

openai.short_description: Release readiness check without performing release
openai.default_prompt: Use $aql-release-check to assess release readiness read-only and report blockers without performing a release act.

routes.name: aql-resume
routes.description: Explicit resume route: reconstruction-first continuation from artifacts. Initial authority is read; do not inherit prior external or release authority.
routes.handoff: Reconstruct goal, scope, and evidence from artifacts, then propose the next safe step. Re-derive authority before any write or external act.

openai.short_description: Resume work from artifacts without inherited release authority
openai.default_prompt: Use $aql-resume to reconstruct this task from artifacts and continue with read-only authority until scope is reconfirmed.
